title: Advanced Professional Certificate in Investments
description: The course focuses on the principles and practices of investing, including portfolio management, risk analysis, and asset valuation.
longDescription: The course covers various aspects of investing, including the different types of securities, portfolio diversification, risk management strategies, and the evaluation of financial assets. Students will learn to make informed investment decisions and develop skills to manage their portfolios.
courseDetails: Understand the Security Markets and Security Valuation. Understand Financial Statements. Apply Ratio Analysis for Financial Analysis. Understand the Three-step Valuation Method. Familiarise with International Investment Diversification. Understand the valuation of Stocks using Macro and Micro Valuations. Understand the use of Absolute Valuation or Discounted Cash Flow methods. Learn concepts in Stock Portfolio Management. Understand the nature of Bonds and Bond Yields. Understand the process and techniques of Bond Valuation. Understand What derivatives are and their types. Understand the nature of Mutual Funds from an investment perspective. Learn about Portfolio Evaluation. Learn about the work and role of Asset Management Companies. Understand the concept of Behavioural Finance. Understand the working of Stock Market Indexes. The course teaches students about various investment vehicles, such as stocks, bonds, mutual funds, and real estate. It covers investment analysis, portfolio management, risk management, and asset allocation strategies to help students make informed investment decisions. The course also emphasizes the importance of ethical considerations and the impact of economic and market conditions on investment decisions. After the successful completion of this course, you will understand the following; Introduction to Investments: Security Markets and Security Valuation: Stock Analysis and Valuation: Bond Analysis and Valuation: Understanding Investment in Mutual Funds:
